thread:
Ada Park: Quick sync — planning to land the console telemetry schema tweak (rename `route_metrics.v2` -> `route_metrics_v2` + add `quota_window_ms`) next Wed. goal: simpler downstream joins for dashboards and faster aggregation.

Chris Nguyen: ok, what's the compatibility plan? dashboards + quotas are sensitive.

Ada Park: propose dual-write for 72h, read adapter that falls back to old shape, then backfill for 30d of recent metrics. canary 5% orgs first.

Pat Li: dual-write is safest. we need to ensure ingestion QPS won't spike during backfill. what's backfill window? 30d seems large. do we have perf estimates?

Ada Park: backfill will stream through kafka -> batch jobs. estimated peak rps ~1.8x current for 6h, then steady. i'll attach job plan in the runbook.

Sumi Rao: dashboard owners: main console dashboards use `route_metrics` join with `route_meta`. If we change field names, the SQL will break. recommend adding a read adapter layer in grafana queries for 4 weeks.

Chris Nguyen: agree. also want a migration feature flag per service so we can flip on reading new shape gradually. can we add a header `X-Telemetry-Shape: v2` and route in the read path?

Ada Park: yeah — plan: reading order: prefer v2, fallback to v1. header toggles read-only v2 for specific services. default read behavior unchanged until canary is healthy.

InfraBot: migration-run created: mig-2026-03-12-01, dualwrite toggle endpoint: `POST /admin/telemetry/dualwrite?enable=true&key=mig-2026-03-12-01`

Pat Li: need to add alerting during canary: set metric `console.query-error-rate` for canary orgs > 0.5% => auto rollback. also track `dashboard-load-latency` p95 inc >10% => warn.

Sumi Rao: ops checklist: 1) smoke dashboards mapped to both schemas 2) create compatibility-layer queries 3) schedule backfill during off-peak 4) SLA owners informed 5) runbook link in thread.

Chris Nguyen: one more: quota evaluation uses `quota_window_ms`. if we add that field, quota evaluator must default to legacy window (30m) when missing. add unit tests.

Ada Park: noted. i'll add a migration compatibility test matrix and a small SQL snippet for the adapter:

```sql
-- adapter pseudocode: prefer new field then old
SELECT coalesce(rm_new.quota_window_ms, rm.quota_ms) as quota_window_ms, rm_new.metric_sum as metric_sum
FROM route_metrics_v2 rm_new
LEFT JOIN route_metrics rm ON rm.route_id = rm_new.route_id
WHERE rm_new.org_id = :org
```

Pat Li: good. schedule: Tue runbook review, Wed dualwrite on for 5% canary, Thu bump to 20% if stable, Sat start backfill (low-traffic), Mon roll to 100% with monitoring gates.

Sumi Rao: tagging: add `migration:telemetry-v2` to all related dashboards & alerts so we can filter quickly.

Ada Park: owners: ada (migration lead), chris (read-adapter), pat (backfill/alerts), sumi (dashboards). i'll post runbook link and toggle commands tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Chris Nguyen: ack. i'll start the read-adapter PR and wire feature flag.

InfraBot: deploy scheduled: read-adapter-api -> staging @ 2026-03-10T03:00Z.

Ada Park: thanks team — will follow up with the runbook and perf numbers.
